name: Arik Product Fields
author: Tanmoy Biswas

sections.description:
Arik Product Fields is a powerful, user-friendly plugin for WooCommerce that gives you complete control over your products and checkout process. Effortlessly add a wide variety of custom fields to your products, including text fields, WYSIWYG editors, taxonomy selectors, and embedded video.

Beyond just product fields, this plugin provides a full suite of options to customize your store. Create custom product tabs with their own titles and content, hide the default WooCommerce tabs, modify the checkout page, and much more—all without writing a single line of code.

Key Features:
* Add 10+ custom field types to your WooCommerce products.
* Includes Text, Textarea, Email, WYSIWYG, oEmbed Video, and Taxonomy Selectors.
* Create a custom product tab with a unique title and content for each product.
* Option to hide the default “Description” and “Additional Information” tabs on a per-product basis.
* Enable a “Buy Now” button that skips the cart and goes directly to checkout.
* Modify the WooCommerce checkout page: hide fields, reorder fields, and more.
* Modify your general store: hide the reviews tab or the cart coupon field.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the arik-product-fields folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the new “Arik Product Fields” menu in your WordPress dashboard to configure the global settings.
  4. Go to any product editor screen to find the “Arik Product Fields” meta box to add custom data and configure product tabs.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial public release on WordPress.org.
  • Refactored all code to meet WordPress.org security and coding standards.
